commands:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(uname -s)" = Darwin || exit 41
WORK="$(mktemp -d /tmp/bloomml-wur-repro.XXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$WORK"' EXIT
export WORK
git clone --quiet --depth 1 --single-branch --branch research/simulator-fidelity-kaggle-20261103 https://github.com/MichalMatu/bloomml.git "$WORK/source"
sha="$(git -C "$WORK/source" rev-parse HEAD)"
test "$sha" = 685c68e62723e2dd2a7bb701e78a7ed05e62e3c7 || { echo 'SOURCE_SHA_MISMATCH'; exit 42; }
printf 'RESEARCH_CODE_SHA|%s\n' "$sha"
cd "$WORK/source"
python3 -m compileall -q tools/ml/wur_external_benchmark.py tests/test_wur_external_benchmark.py
echo 'WUR_COMPILE|PASS'
python3 -m unittest -v tests.test_wur_external_benchmark
echo 'WUR_UNITTEST|PASS'
kaggle datasets download -d piantic/autonomous-greenhouse-challengeagc-2nd-2019 -p "$WORK" >/dev/null
ARCHIVE="$(find "$WORK" -maxdepth 1 -name '*.zip' -print -quit)"
test -n "$ARCHIVE"
python3 -m tools.ml.wur_external_benchmark --zip "$ARCHIVE" --output "$WORK/wur-benchmark.json"
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import os,json
j=json.loads((Path(os.environ['WORK'])/'wur-benchmark.json').read_text())
assert j['total_climate_rows']==286854
assert j['original_archive_byte_equivalence']=='NOT_VERIFIED'
assert len(j['sites'])==6
assert j['training_approval']=='EXPLORATORY_ONLY_ORIGINAL_VERIFICATION_PENDING'
assert j['clock_basis']=='excel_serial_naive_5min_timezone_unverified'
print('WUR_MIRROR_AUDIT|PASS')
print('WUR_MIRROR_SHA256|'+j['mirror_sha256'])
print('WUR_WEATHER|'+json.dumps({k:j['weather'].get(k) for k in ('rows','coverage','source_tick_deltas_5min','warnings')},ensure_ascii=False,separators=(',',':')))
for house in j['sites']:
 baseline=house['baseline']
 metrics={target:baseline[f'{target}@{h}min']
          for target in ('temperature_c','relative_humidity_pct','co2_ppm','reported_par_umol_m2_s')
          for h in (5,15,60)}
 print('WUR_REAL_SITE|'+json.dumps({'site':house['site'],'rows':house['rows'],'first':house['first_date_unverified_timezone'],
 'last':house['last_date_unverified_timezone'],'coverage':house['coverage'],'ranges':house['observed_ranges'],
 'holdout_cutoff':house['holdout_cutoff_naive_day'],'holdout_rows':house['holdout_rows'],
 'timestamp_gaps':house['source_tick_deltas_5min'],
 'weather_matching':house['weather_matching_exact_timestamps'],
 'warnings':house['warnings'],'baseline':metrics},ensure_ascii=False,separators=(',',':')))
print('WUR_SOURCE_ORIGINAL_EQUIVALENCE|NOT_VERIFIED')
print('WUR_REPRO_DONE|PASS_EXPLORATORY_ONLY')
PY
